item.title: 3D Pop Up Christmas Card SVG
item.description:
CHRISTMAS EVE AT THE FRONT DOOR — 3D POP-UP CHRISTMAS CARD BUNDLE (PRINT THEN CUT + SVG/DXF)
Create a heartwarming, keepsake 5" x 7" 3D pop-up Christmas card that folds completely flat into a standard A7 envelope!
The closed card features a festive cranberry-red front door with a lush evergreen wreath and brass letterbox. When your recipient opens the card, a snowy 3D front porch pops forward—revealing an adorable golden retriever puppy sitting on a welcome mat holding a heart-sealed Christmas envelope, with the message: “There’s always a place for you at Christmas.”
